title: Pentaho Solution Architect - High Availability Specialty
description: Deploy the Pentaho Server for high availability: two server nodes behind an HAProxy pair with a Keepalived virtual IP, one shared PostgreSQL repository, the Jackrabbit cluster journal and clustered Quartz, then Carte clustering for Pentaho Data Integration execution and Tray.io driving it through the Carte REST API.

moduleSummaries.title: Getting Started
moduleSummaries.summary: How to get the most out of this guide, and the hosts the cluster needs: eight Ubuntu machines on one subnet, the Pentaho Server and Pentaho Data Integration archives, and time kept in step on all of them.

moduleSummaries.title: High Availability
moduleSummaries.summary: Production HA from the installation guide: two Pentaho nodes behind an HAProxy pair with Keepalived VIP failover, a shared PostgreSQL 14 repository, the Jackrabbit cluster journal and Quartz clustering - plus Carte clustering for Pentaho Data Integration execution and Tray.io driving event-based ETL through the Carte REST API.
